storyNotes: 5,792 directed airport pairs, 335 airports, 601,582 flights in July 2023.
Busiest pairs: HNL->OGG (1104), OGG->HNL (1103), SFO->LAX (959), LAX->SFO (940), LAX->LAS (868).
Busiest airports (in+out flights): ATL (59,834), DFW (52,019), DEN (51,185), ORD (45,584), LAX (35,041), CLT (33,957).
Mean departure delay is 21.3 min and 2.4% of flights were cancelled; worst mean delay among pairs with >=100 flights: LAS->BOS (98 min).
Weights are skewed: the top 10% of pairs carry 37% of flights, a classic case for flow aggregation and edge bundling.
